digest.component_or_area: OIDC/JWKS JWT verifier in mcp auth strategies
propositions: A JWKSTokenVerifier must validate JWT signature, issuer, audience (against auth_resource_server_url), expiration/issuance/not-before claims with configurable leeway, and optional header typ field, using PyJWKClient with explicit algorithm pinning.
The verifier must refuse startup if symmetric algorithms (HS256/HS384/HS512) are configured alongside a JWKS source to prevent RS256↔HS256 confusion attacks.

Unknown-kid refetch must be rate-limited to at most one fetch per auth_jwt_jwks_refetch_cooldown window (default 30s) under concurrent requests using an asyncio.Lock to prevent TOCTOU double-fetch and DoS via random kid flooding.
JWKS fetch is offloaded to a worker thread via asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking the async event loop; fetch failures raise to deny the request, distinct from invalid tokens which return None.

Construction-time SSRF guards reject http:// jwks_uri and private/link-local hosts by default, require HTTPS, enforce bounded HTTP timeout (default 10s), and accept private hosts only when auth_jwt_allow_private_jwks_host=true.
The verifier sets expires_at from the JWT exp claim as a positive value and stamps resource=auth_resource_server_url so composite audience check passes; scope/scp claims are mapped to scopes.
